WITH 
users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201231' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id)

-- Final answer: the top non-YouTube product purchased by visitors who also bought YouTube products in July 2017
WITH yt_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) LIKE '%youtube%'
),
visitor_products AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM yt_buyers)
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM visitor_products
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Try using conditional MAX with a tie-breaker
-- For each user, get the isMobile of the session with max(date, visitId)
-- We can use: MAX(date) to get last_visit_date, then use that to filter
-- But we need the device of that specific session

-- Alternative: use the visitId of the last session
SELECT 
  fullVisitorId,
  MIN(date) as first_visit_date,
  MAX(date) as last_visit_date,
  -- Get the visitId of the last session
  MAX(visitId) as last_visit_id
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
GROUP BY fullVisitorId
LIMIT 5

WITH inpatient_all AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2011 AS year, average_medicare_payments * total_discharges AS inpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2011`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2012, average_medicare_payments * total_discharges
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2012`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2013, average_medicare_payments * total_discharges
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2013`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2014, average_medicare_payments * total_discharges
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2015, average_medicare_payments * total_discharges
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2015`
),
inpatient_agg AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, year, AVG(inpatient_cost) AS yearly_avg_inpatient_cost
  FROM inpatient_all
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name, year
),
outpatient_all AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2011 AS year, average_total_payments * outpatient_services AS outpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2011`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2012, average_total_payments * outpatient_services
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2012`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2013, average_total_payments * outpatient_services
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2013`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2014, average_total_payments * outpatient_services
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 2015, average_total_payments * outpatient_services
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2015`
),
outpatient_agg AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, year, AVG(outpatient_cost) AS yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
  FROM outpatient_all
  WHERE provider_id = '330101'
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name, year
)
SELECT 
  i.year AS calendar_year,
  i.yearly_avg_inpatient_cost,
  o.yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
FROM inpatient_agg i
JOIN outpatient_agg o ON i.year = o.year
ORDER BY i.year

WITH quinapril_related_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drug_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength`
  WHERE ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
),
persons_using_quinapril AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
  JOIN quinapril_related_drugs qrd
    ON de.drug_concept_id = qrd.drug_concept_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) as total_persons,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pu.person_id) as persons_using_quinapril,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT pu.person_id) as persons_not_using_quinapril,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT pu.person_id), COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id)) * 100, 2) as percentage_not_using_quinapril
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` p
LEFT JOIN persons_using_quinapril pu
  ON p.person_id = pu.person_id

-- Get the latitude of the final coordinates for the hurricane with the second longest distance
WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, iso_time, latitude, longitude,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude) AS geo_point,
    LAG(ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude)) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_geo_point
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA'
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, 
    ST_DISTANCE(geo_point, prev_geo_point) AS segment_distance
  FROM storm_tracks
  WHERE prev_geo_point IS NOT NULL
),
storm_distances AS (
  SELECT sid, name, SUM(segment_distance) AS total_distance_meters
  FROM distances
  GROUP BY sid, name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT sid, name, total_distance_meters,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC) AS rn
  FROM storm_distances
)
SELECT r.name, r.total_distance_meters, 
       h.latitude AS final_latitude,
       h.longitude AS final_longitude,
       h.iso_time AS final_time
FROM ranked r
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h 
  ON r.sid = h.sid
WHERE r.rn = 2
  AND h.iso_time = (
    SELECT MAX(iso_time) 
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` 
    WHERE sid = r.sid
  )

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude) AS geo_point
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' 
    AND season = '2020'
    AND sid = '2020233N14313'
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    geo_point,
    LAG(geo_point) OVER (ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_geo_point
  FROM storm_points
),
with_distance AS (
  SELECT 
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    geo_point,
    COALESCE(ST_DISTANCE(geo_point, prev_geo_point), 0) / 1000 AS segment_km
  FROM with_prev
)
SELECT 
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind,
  SUM(segment_km) OVER (ORDER BY iso_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_distance_km
FROM with_distance
ORDER BY iso_time

WITH country_temps AS (
  SELECT 
    s.country,
    g.date,
    g.max,
    g.min,
    g.temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s 
    ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE g.mo = '10' 
    AND g.da BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
    AND g.temp != 9999.9
    AND g.max != 9999.9
    AND g.min != 9999.9
),
country_daily_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    date,
    AVG(max) as avg_max,
    AVG(min) as avg_min,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM country_temps
  GROUP BY country, date
),
us_data AS (
  SELECT date, avg_max as us_max, avg_min as us_min, avg_temp as us_avg
  FROM country_daily_avg
  WHERE country = 'US'
),
uk_data AS (
  SELECT date, avg_max as uk_max, avg_min as uk_min, avg_temp as uk_avg
  FROM country_daily_avg
  WHERE country = 'UK'
)
SELECT 
  d.date,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(us.us_max, 1) - uk.uk_max, 1) as diff_max_temp,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(us.us_min, 1) - uk.uk_min, 1) as diff_min_temp,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(us.us_avg, 1) - uk.uk_avg, 1) as diff_avg_temp
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT date FROM country_daily_avg) d
LEFT JOIN us_data us ON d.date = us.date
LEFT JOIN uk_data uk ON d.date = uk.date
ORDER BY d.date

WITH nearby_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name, lat, lon
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE lat != 0.0 AND lon != 0.0
    AND ST_DWITHIN(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(lon, lat),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197),
      20 * 1609.34
    )
),
weather_data AS (
  SELECT stn, wban, year, temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
    AND temp != 9999.9
)
SELECT 
  ns.name AS station_name,
  ns.usaf AS station_id,
  ns.wban,
  ns.lat,
  ns.lon,
  COUNT(wd.stn) as valid_temp_observations
FROM nearby_stations ns
LEFT JOIN weather_data wd ON ns.usaf = wd.stn AND ns.wban = wd.wban
GROUP BY ns.usaf, ns.wban, ns.name, ns.lat, ns.lon
ORDER BY ns.usaf, ns.wban

WITH complaint_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2010-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY complaint_date, complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_date, SUM(daily_count) as total_daily_count
  FROM complaint_daily
  GROUP BY complaint_date
),
temp_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY weather_date
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    c.complaint_date,
    c.complaint_type,
    c.daily_count,
    t.avg_temp,
    d.total_daily_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.daily_count * 100.0, d.total_daily_count) as daily_pct
  FROM complaint_daily c
  INNER JOIN temp_daily t ON c.complaint_date = t.weather_date
  INNER JOIN daily_totals d ON c.complaint_date = d.complaint_date
),
complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(daily_count) as total_complaints
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,
    ct.total_complaints,
    COUNT(*) as days_with_temp,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_count) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_count),
      SQRT(
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) - POWER(SUM(j.avg_temp), 2))
        * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.daily_count * j.daily_count) - POWER(SUM(j.daily_count), 2))
      )
    ) as temp_vs_count_corr,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_pct) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_pct),
      SQRT(
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) - POWER(SUM(j.avg_temp), 2))
        * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.daily_pct * j.daily_pct) - POWER(SUM(j.daily_pct), 2))
      )
    ) as temp_vs_pct_corr
  FROM joined j
  INNER JOIN complaint_totals ct ON j.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
  GROUP BY j.complaint_type, ct.total_complaints
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_complaints,
  days_with_temp,
  ROUND(temp_vs_count_corr, 4) as temp_vs_count_corr,
  ROUND(temp_vs_pct_corr, 4) as temp_vs_pct_corr
FROM correlations
WHERE ABS(temp_vs_count_corr) > 0.5
ORDER BY complaint_type

WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Poor') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.spc_latin, b.spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    COALESCE(a.spc_common, b.spc_common) AS spc_common,
    COALESCE(a.total, 0) AS total_1995,
    COALESCE(b.total, 0) AS total_2015,
    COALESCE(a.alive, 0) AS alive_1995,
    COALESCE(b.alive, 0) AS alive_2015,
    COALESCE(a.dead, 0) AS dead_1995,
    COALESCE(b.dead, 0) AS dead_2015,
    COALESCE(b.total, 0) - COALESCE(a.total, 0) AS total_growth,
    COALESCE(b.alive, 0) - COALESCE(a.alive, 0) AS alive_growth,
    COALESCE(b.dead, 0) - COALESCE(a.dead, 0) AS dead_growth
  FROM y1995 a
  FULL OUTER JOIN y2015 b ON a.spc_latin = b.spc_latin
)
SELECT 
  spc_latin,
  spc_common,
  total_1995,
  total_2015,
  alive_1995,
  alive_2015,
  dead_1995,
  dead_2015,
  total_growth,
  alive_growth,
  dead_growth
FROM combined
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tip_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    z.borough as pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` z
    ON t.pickup_location_id = z.zone_id
  WHERE DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-07'
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
    AND z.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
),
trips_with_tip_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100
    END as tip_rate
  FROM filtered_trips
),
tip_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_rate,
    CASE 
      WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN tip_rate > 0 AND tip_rate <= 5 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 5 AND tip_rate <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 10 AND tip_rate <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 15 AND tip_rate <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 20 AND tip_rate <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 25 THEN 'More than 25%'
    END as tip_category
  FROM trips_with_tip_rate
),
counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_category,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM tip_categories
  GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY pickup_borough
)
SELECT 
  c.pickup_borough,
  c.tip_category,
  c.trip_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(c.trip_count, t.total_trips) as proportion
FROM counts c
JOIN totals t ON c.pickup_borough = t.pickup_borough
ORDER BY c.pickup_borough, c.tip_category

SELECT 
    r.route_short_name,
    t.trip_headsign,
    MIN(st1.departure_time) AS earliest_departure_clay,
    MAX(st2.arrival_time) AS latest_arrival_sacramento
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st1
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st2 
    ON st1.trip_id = st2.trip_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` t
    ON CAST(st1.trip_id AS STRING) = t.trip_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.routes` r
    ON t.route_id = r.route_id
WHERE st1.stop_id = 14015
  AND st2.stop_id = 16294
  AND st1.stop_sequence < st2.stop_sequence
GROUP BY r.route_short_name, t.trip_headsign
ORDER BY r.route_short_name, t.trip_headsign

WITH covid_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_name, country_code, cumulative_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE date = DATE('2020-06-30')
    AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND cumulative_confirmed IS NOT NULL
),
wb_pop AS (
  SELECT country, country_code, year_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2018 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 > 0
    AND country_code NOT IN ('WLD','IBT','LMY','MIC','IBD','EAR','LMC','UMC','EAS','LTE','EAP','TEA','TSA','SAS','IDA','OED','HIC','PST','IDX','SSF','TSS','SSA')
)
SELECT 
  c.country_name,
  c.country_code,
  c.cumulative_confirmed,
  p.year_2018 AS population_2018,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cumulative_confirmed, p.year_2018) * 100, 4) AS percentage_confirmed
FROM covid_cases c
LEFT JOIN wb_pop p ON c.country_name = p.country
WHERE c.country_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY percentage_confirmed DESC

WITH daily_new AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    county,
    state_name,
    confirmed_cases,
    confirmed_cases - LAG(confirmed_cases) OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY date) AS new_cases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_nyt.us_counties`
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-05-31' AND state_name = 'Illinois'
),
daily_top5 AS (
  SELECT date, county, new_cases,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY new_cases DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_new
  WHERE new_cases IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT county, COUNT(*) as top5_frequency
FROM daily_top5
WHERE rn <= 5
GROUP BY county
ORDER BY top5_frequency DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH 
tracts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.geo_id,
    t.tract_geom,
    c.total_pop,
    c.income_per_capita,
    c.total_pop * c.income_per_capita AS total_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` c
    ON t.geo_id = c.geo_id
),
zip_codes_near AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
    internal_point_geom,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833),
    5 * 1609.344
  )
  AND state_code = 'WA'
),
intersections AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    tr.total_pop,
    tr.total_income,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) AS intersection_area,
    ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom) AS tract_area
  FROM tracts tr
  CROSS JOIN zip_codes_near z
  WHERE ST_INTERSECTS(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
),
allocations AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    SUM(total_pop * (intersection_area / NULLIF(tract_area, 0))) AS allocated_pop,
    SUM(total_income * (intersection_area / NULLIF(tract_area, 0))) AS allocated_income
  FROM intersections
  GROUP BY zip_code
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(allocated_pop, 1) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(allocated_income, allocated_pop), 1) AS average_individual_income
FROM allocations
ORDER BY average_individual_income DESC

SELECT * FROM (
  -- Category 1: Top Venues
  SELECT 
    'Top Venues' AS Category,
    'N/A' AS Date,
    venue_name AS `Matchup or Venue`,
    venue_capacity AS `Key Metric`
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams`
  GROUP BY venue_name, venue_capacity
  HAVING venue_capacity IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY venue_capacity DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  -- Category 2: Biggest Championship Margins
  SELECT 
    'Biggest Championship Margins' AS Category,
    CAST(game_date AS STRING) AS Date,
    CONCAT(win_market, ' vs ', lose_market) AS `Matchup or Venue`,
    (win_pts - lose_pts) AS `Key Metric`
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE round = 2 AND season > 2015
  ORDER BY `Key Metric` DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  -- Category 3: Highest Scoring Games
  SELECT 
    'Highest Scoring Games' AS Category,
    CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS Date,
    CONCAT(h_market, ' vs ', a_market) AS `Matchup or Venue`,
    (h_points + a_points) AS `Key Metric`
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_games_sr`
  WHERE season > 2010
  ORDER BY `Key Metric` DESC

SELECT 
    a.consecutive_number,
    a.hour_of_crash,
    a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital,
    a.hour_of_arrival_at_scene,
    CASE 
        WHEN a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital BETWEEN 0 AND 23 
        THEN a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital - a.hour_of_crash
        ELSE NULL
    END AS delay_to_hospital,
    CASE 
        WHEN a.hour_of_arrival_at_scene BETWEEN 0 AND 23

        ELSE NULL
    END AS delay_to_scene,

        WHEN p.restraint_system_helmet_use = 1 THEN 0.33
        WHEN p.restraint_system_helmet_use = 2 THEN 0.67

WITH all_paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD'
),
patient_mutations AS (
  SELECT 
    ParticipantBarcode,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53') AND FILTER = 'PASS'
  GROUP BY ParticipantBarcode
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT 
    ap.ParticipantBarcode,
    pm.has_kras,
    pm.has_tp53,
    CASE 
      WHEN pm.has_kras = 1 AND pm.has_tp53 = 1 THEN 'both'
      WHEN pm.has_kras IS NULL AND pm.has_tp53 IS NULL THEN 'neither'
      WHEN pm.has_kras = 0 AND pm.has_tp53 = 0 THEN 'neither'
      ELSE 'one_only'
    END as status
  FROM all_paad_patients ap
  LEFT JOIN patient_mutations pm ON ap.ParticipantBarcode = pm.ParticipantBarcode
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'both' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'neither' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as net_difference
FROM patient_status

    cn.candidate_names,
    qcm.total_small_dollar
FROM qualifying_committees qcm
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_2016` cm ON qcm.cmte_id = cm.cmte_id
INNER JOIN candidate_names cn ON qcm.cmte_id = cn.cmte_id
ORDER BY cm.cmte_nm

WITH zip_bg_overlap AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, b.geo_id as bg_geo_id, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)), b.area_land_meters) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` b
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE z.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)) > 0
),
zip_bank_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(*) as bank_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
zip_bg_stats AS (
  SELECT zbo.zip_code, zbo.overlap_ratio, zbc.bank_count,
         zbc.bank_count * zbo.overlap_ratio / SUM(zbo.overlap_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY zbo.zip_code) as distributed_banks
  FROM zip_bg_overlap zbo
  JOIN zip_bank_counts zbc ON zbo.zip_code = zbc.zip_code
)
SELECT zip_code, 
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(distributed_banks), COUNT(*)) as avg_concentration
FROM zip_bg_stats
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_concentration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH cat_images AS (

),
images_with_cat AS (

),
all_labeled_images AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels` l
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cat_images) as cat_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_labeled_images a 
   WHERE a.image_id NOT IN (SELECT image_id FROM images_with_cat)
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i2 WHERE i2.image_id = a.image_id)) as other_count

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_pseudo_id) AS distinct_users
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e,
UNNEST(e.event_params) AS p
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210131'
  AND e.event_name = 'page_view'
  AND p.key = 'page_location'
  AND p.value.string_value = 'https://shop.googlemerchandisestore.com/'

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT((SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location'), r'https?://[^/]+(.*)') AS path,
    SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT((SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location'), r'https?://[^/]+(.*)'), '/') AS segments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    CASE 
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 4 
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) - 1)], r'\+')
        AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(1)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus.collection|drinkware|electronics|google.redesign|lifestyle|nest|new.2015.logo|notebooks.journals|office|shop.by.brand|small.goods|stationery|wearables)')
          OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(2)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus.collection|drinkware|electronics|google.redesign|lifestyle|nest|new.2015.logo|notebooks.journals|office|shop.by.brand|small.goods|stationery|wearables)'))
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 4
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) - 1)], r'\+')
        AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(1)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus.collection|drinkware|electronics|google.redesign|lifestyle|nest|new.2015.logo|notebooks.journals|office|shop.by.brand|small.goods|stationery|wearables)')
          OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(2)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus.collection|drinkware|electronics|google.redesign|lifestyle|nest|new.2015.logo|notebooks.journals|office|shop.by.brand|small.goods|stationery|wearables)'))
      THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE page_title
    END AS display_page
  FROM page_views
),
with_group AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    display_page,
    CASE WHEN display_page != LAG(display_page) OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_group
  FROM classified
),
with_cumulative_group AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    display_page,
    SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS grp
  FROM with_group
),
deduped AS (
  SELECT display_page, grp, MIN(event_timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM with_cumulative_group
  GROUP BY display_page, grp
)
SELECT 
  '1362228.4966015575' AS user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_page, '>>' ORDER BY first_ts) AS navigation_flow
FROM deduped

WITH session_traffic AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_date,
    (SELECT p.value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) p WHERE p.key = 'ga_session_id') as ga_session_id,
    traffic_source.medium as ts_medium,
    traffic_source.source as ts_source,
    traffic_source.name as ts_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN ts_source = '(direct)' AND ts_medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           AND ts_medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')
           AND ts_medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_source, r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_source, r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           AND ts_medium IN ('social','social-network','social-media','sm','social network','social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*video.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN ts_medium IN ('display','banner','expandable','interstitial','cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN ts_source = 'sms' OR ts_medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') OR ts_medium IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'organic' AND ts_source NOT IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') THEN 'Organic Search'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel
  FROM session_traffic
)
SELECT 
  channel,
  COUNT(*) as session_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY session_count DESC

-- Final result: cohort date and Week 2 retention rate as percentage
WITH user_first_touch AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) as first_touch_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
),
all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
user_first_session AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, MIN(event_date) as first_session_date
  FROM all_sessions
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
new_users AS (
  SELECT ufs.user_pseudo_id
  FROM user_first_session ufs
  INNER JOIN user_first_touch uft ON ufs.user_pseudo_id = uft.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ufs.first_session_date) = uft.first_touch_date
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    ufs.user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ufs.first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ufs.first_session_date)) - 2) DAY) as cohort_week_start
  FROM user_first_session ufs
  INNER JOIN new_users nu ON ufs.user_pseudo_id = nu.user_pseudo_id
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week_start,
    COUNT(*) as cohort_size
  FROM user_cohort
  WHERE cohort_week_start BETWEEN '2018-07-09' AND '2018-09-17'
  GROUP BY cohort_week_start
),
retained AS (
  SELECT 
    c.cohort_week_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_pseudo_id) as retained_count
  FROM user_cohort c
  INNER JOIN all_sessions s 
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = s.user_pseudo_id
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.event_date) = DATE_ADD(c.cohort_week_start, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
  WHERE c.cohort_week_start BETWEEN '2018-07-09' AND '2018-09-17'
  GROUP BY c.cohort_week_start
)
SELECT 
  cs.cohort_week_start,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(r.retained_count, 0), cs.cohort_size) * 100, 2) as week2_retention_rate
FROM cohort_sizes cs
LEFT JOIN retained r ON cs.cohort_week_start = r.cohort_week_start
ORDER BY cs.cohort_week_start

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, user_first_touch_timestamp
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
),
cohort_with_date AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    user_first_touch_timestamp,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) as first_open_date_shanghai
  FROM cohort
  WHERE DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-07'
),
cohort_user_ids AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, first_open_date_shanghai
  FROM cohort_with_date
),
week1_retained AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180902' AND '20181008'
    AND e.user_pseudo_id IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM cohort_user_ids)
),
week2_retained AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180909' AND '20181014'
    AND e.user_pseudo_id IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM cohort_user_ids)
),
week3_retained AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180915' AND '20181020'
    AND e.user_pseudo_id IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM cohort_user_ids)
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort_user_ids) as total_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM week1_retained) as week1_active,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM week2_retained) as week2_active,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM week3_retained) as week3_active
